RESTON, Va., Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — V2X, Inc. (NYSE:VVX ) is excited to announce an expanded collaboration with Microsoft to advance the next generation of AI-powered mission operations. Building on an established relationship, the collaboration combines V2X’s operational and engineering expertise with Microsoft Foundry and Microsoft Fabric to accelerate innovation, strengthen readiness and address evolving mission requirements.


V2X engineers will utilize Foundry and Fabric to develop solutions for complex operational challenges, including contested logistics, supply chain resilience and mission sustainment. A key focus includes developing digital twins of operating environments to enhance planning, modeling and decision-making across geographically dispersed missions, including remote locations in the Indo-Pacific region and large-scale logistics operations.


“Advancing the mission requires more than adopting new technologies. It requires bringing together the right expertise and partnerships to solve our customers’ most complex challenges,” said Jeremy C. Wensinger, President and Chief Executive Officer of V2X. “Our expanded collaboration with Microsoft builds on a strong foundation, combining V2X’s mission expertise with Microsoft’s advanced technology capabilities to accelerate innovation and deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers.”


V2X will utilize Foundry to support flexible, multi-model AI deployment across complex cloud environments, enabling V2X engineers to develop and adapt applications for demanding operational requirements. Fabric will also enable opportunities to connect and analyze information across multiple data sources, accelerating access to actionable insights without creating entirely new data environments.


“Mission programs require secure AI frameworks that provide model choice and the flexibility to address complex operational requirements,” said Chris Barry, President, U.S. Public Sector Industries, Microsoft. “V2X integration with Microsoft Foundry and Fabric is helping customers apply trusted cloud and AI capabilities to accelerate innovation and develop adaptable solutions for their most challenging mission requirements.”


**About V2X**
V2X builds innovative solutions that integrate physical and digital environments by aligning people, actions, and technology. V2X is embedded in all elements of a critical mission’s lifecycle to enhance readiness, optimize resource management, and boost security. The company provides innovation spanning national security, defense, civilian, and international markets. With a global team of approximately 16,000 professionals, V2X enables mission success by injecting AI and machine learning capabilities to meet today’s toughest challenges across all operational domains.
